name: Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket
description:
The purpose of the `BluetoothSocketServer` object is to listen for incoming connection requests
and provide a connected `BluetoothSocket` after a request is accepted.

methods.name: close
methods.description:
This method, when called, closes the server socket. One cannot start accepting connections
again after calling this method. On error, this method will throw an exception.

methods.name: isAccepting
methods.summary: Determines whether the server socket is currently accepting connections.

returns.summary: True if the server socket is accepting connections, false otherwise.

methods.name: startAccept
methods.summary: Inform the server socket to start accepting incoming connections.
methods.description:
This method, when called, starts listening for the incoming Bluetooth connections and block
until a connection is established. Listen for the 
[connectionReceived](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket#connectionReceived) event to be
notified when a connection is received or the [error](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket#error)
event when an error occured during accepting connection.

parameters.name: keepListening
parameters.summary: Defines whether the server socket should keep listening after an incoming connection was received. If this parameter is false, it will stop accepting connections after a single connection is recieved.

methods.name: stopAccept
methods.summary: Inform the server socket to stop accepting incoming connections.
methods.description:
This method, when called stop accepting incoming connections. One can again start accepting
connections via [startAccept](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket#startAccept) method
after calling this method. On error, this method will throw an exception.

events.name: connectionReceived
events.summary: Fired when the server socket receives an incoming connection.

properties.name: socket
properties.summary: The socket object bind to the connection.

events.name: error
events.summary: Fired when a socket operation fails.
